_doc: Bot banter corpus shared by game.js (single-player) and rooms/botlib.php (multiplayer). Groups hold one-liners keyed by personality (chill/chaotic/brutal/honest/liar) plus 'any' for personality-neutral lines. Placeholders: {me} {target} {leader} {loser} {card} {opt} {tally} {lap} {laps} {ap} {sp} {n}. Engines fill unknown placeholders verbatim, so a typo never crashes a game.

any: {me} slides in late with snacks. Priorities.
{me} joins. The awkwardness is now contractually binding.

chill: Alright, low stakes, good vibes. Let's roll.
I'm just here to watch someone embarrass themselves.
Slow start, strong finish. That's my strategy.
chaotic: I'M GOING FIRST ENERGY EVEN WHEN I'M NOT FIRST.
Someone's getting sabotaged tonight. I don't know who. I don't need to.
I flipped a coin. It said chaos.
brutal: I didn't come to make friends. I came to win.
Pick a token you don't like. It'll be moving backwards soon.
Mercy is for losers and I intend to keep it that way.
honest: I promise to answer everything truthfully. This may go badly.
Full transparency: I'm probably going to lose. Still excited!
Honesty policy engaged. Please vote kindly.
liar: Everything I say this game is legally fiction.
I've never told a lie in my life. See? Started already.
Trust me. That's all I'll say. Trust me.
any: Good luck everyone. You'll need it.

chill: Eh, sure. I've done worse at family dinners.
Fine, I'll do it. It builds character, apparently.
Okay okay, doing it. No big deal.
chaotic: OH I'M DOING IT. I'M DOING IT RIGHT NOW.
You can't hurt me. I have no shame left.
Doing it at MAXIMUM VOLUME.
brutal: Done. Next.
That's it? I've embarrassed myself worse on a Tuesday.
Watch and learn, amateurs.
honest: Okay, truthfully? This one hits close to home.
I'll do it, but I want it on record that I'm uncomfortable.
Doing it honestly. Whatever happens, happens.
liar: I totally did that. Yesterday. Twice.
Oh I've got a story about that. None of it's true.
Consider it done. Don't check the details.

chill: I'll just… say I did it. Nobody checks, right?
Confident nod. Confident nod. That's the whole plan.
chaotic: I DID IT AND I'D DO IT AGAIN. (I didn't do it.)
BLUFFING SO HARD RIGHT NOW.
Truth is a spectrum and I'm living in the gray.
brutal: I'm lying and none of you can prove it.
Call my bluff. I dare you. I double dare you.
Fake it with conviction. That's a life skill.
honest: I'm… pretending I did it. This feels illegal.
Lying is hard. This is me lying. Probably obviously.
Okay, attempting a bluff. Sorry in advance.
liar: Hold my beverage. Watch this.
This is my home turf.
Born for this. Made for this. Lied for this.
any: That definitely happened to me. Definitely.

chill: You got me. Respect the instincts.
chaotic: I REGRET NOTHING AND ALSO EVERYTHING.
THE SYSTEM WORKS. UNFORTUNATELY.
CAUGHT?? IN 4K??
brutal: Lucky guess. It won't happen again.
Fine. You got one. Enjoy it.
I allowed that. For entertainment.
honest: I knew I shouldn't have lied. My face did a thing, didn't it?
Caught. I'm going to think about this later in the shower.
Note to self: never lie. Back to honesty.
liar: The jury was rigged.
Amateur detectives. All of you.
One caught lie doesn't define a legacy.

any: And THAT is why you always trust me.
Going with {opt}. Don't make me say it twice.
{opt} felt safer. It was not. I know that now.
Hard pass. Take my shame points.
I have a reputation. Somewhere. With someone.

chill: Eh, worst case I'm embarrassed. I live here.
chaotic: RISK IT ALL. NO THOUGHTS ONLY DICE.
YES. YES. A THOUSAND TIMES YES.
I was BORN on the risk tile.
brutal: Risking. I don't do chicken.
Weak players fold here. Watch.
All in. Obviously.
honest: The odds say no but my heart says maybe?
Taking the risk. Reporting back honestly either way.
Statistically unwise. Doing it anyway.
liar: I've already won this risk in three other timelines.
Risks are just lies you tell probability.
Taking it. What could possibly go wrong? (Everything.)
any: Doing '{card}'. If I go down, I go down weird.

chill: Nah. Pass. Keeping my shame low.
chaotic: I CHICKENED OUT AND I'M FURIOUS ABOUT IT.
MY BODY SAID NO. TRAITOR BODY.
THE CHICKEN WON. THIS TIME.
brutal: Strategic retreat. Nothing more.
I was testing you. You passed. Moving on.
Hmph. Next tile.
honest: I'm chickening out and I'm not proud of it.
Full disclosure: too scared. Sorry.
The coward's path. I choose it freely.
liar: That wasn't chickening out. That was a feint.
I never intended to take it. Psychology.
A true master knows which battles to fake.

any: PAID OFF. Look at those points.

chill: Ouch. Okay. It's fine. Everything's fine.
Adding that to the therapy list.
chaotic: IT BLEW UP IN MY FACE AND I'D DO IT AGAIN.
DISASTER. CINEMA.
I HAVE MADE A HUGE MISTAKE.
brutal: …We don't talk about that.
The dice are cowards.
Temporary setback. Remember that phrase.
honest: I lost the risk. Honestly? Devastated.
Reporting a failure. It hurts.
The odds were right. I was wrong.
liar: I meant to lose that. Long game.
That went exactly as planned.
Sabotage by the universe. Noted.
any: F in the chat for me.
The risk was not worth it. Historians will agree.

chill: Had to. You were getting comfy, {target}.
chaotic: {target}!! IT'S SABOTAGE O'CLOCK.
SORRY {target} NOT SORRY.
{target} I CHOSE VIOLENCE.
brutal: {target}. You're in my way. Simple math.
Nothing personal, {target}. Entirely points-based.
Sorry, {target}. I'm not here to make friends.
honest: {target}, I'm sorry, but strategically this is correct.
I'm sabotaging {target} and I feel terrible about it.
{target}: it's business. I'll apologize after the game.
liar: {target}, someone TOLD me you did something. Who? Can't say.
This isn't sabotage, {target}. It's… accountability.
I would never sabotage you, {target}. Anyway, sabotaging you.
any: {target} won't see it coming. Except they just did.
Picking on {target} for the greater good. My good.
I've been SABOTAGED. In my own house.
Wait. WAIT. That was aimed at me??
Noted. Filed. Will remember at the vote.
Nothing happens. I love nothing happening.
A moment of peace in the shame arena.
One more lap down. My dignity isn't.
Lap bonus acquired. Slowly but surely.
CHAOS TILE. I didn't choose this. It chose me.
Chaos card. My favorite and least favorite.
Double Trouble. Two cards? In THIS economy?
Twice the cards, twice the regret.
Hello first place. I live here now.
Look at me. LOOK at me.
New leader on the board. Try not to panic.
You won't even notice me sneaking up.
The gap is closing. Sleep well.

chill: Everyone vote on {target}. Be nice. Be fair.
Judging {target}. Try to be chill about it.
chaotic: JURY TIME. {target} IS ON TRIAL. MAXIMUM DRAMA.
EVERYBODY LOOK AT {target}. LOOK AT THEM.
Verdict on {target}!! Make it SPICY.
brutal: Judge {target}. Harshly. I'll be watching.
{target} is on trial. I've already decided.
Justice is a group activity. Convict {target}.
honest: Let's be fair to {target}. Only honest votes.
Deliberating on {target}. I'll vote my conscience.
Group judgment on {target}. Please be kind but honest.
liar: I have DEFINITELY seen {target} do worse.
Whatever you heard about {target}, it's true. Trust me.
{target} did that. I saw it. (I didn't see it.)
any: {target}, defend yourself. Actually, too late. Vote!

chill: I believe you. Mostly. Voting yes.
chaotic: YES!! BELIEF!! CHAOS DEMANDS IT.
VOTING YES BECAUSE IT'S FUNNIER.
I BELIEVE EVERYTHING TODAY.
brutal: Yes. Use it well. You won't get another.
Fine. Believed. Once.
Yes. Don't make me regret mercy.
honest: They seem sincere. Voting yes.
Yes — I'd want the same courtesy.
Believed. Honestly.
liar: Believed. A liar recognizes craft.
Yes. Beautiful lie. Ten out of ten.
Yes. I know talent when I see it.

chaotic: NO!! DOUBT!! DOUBT FOR EVERYONE.
VOTING NO BECAUSE IT'S FUNNIER.
LIAR DETECTED. PROBABLY. MAYBE. NO.
brutal: No. Obviously no.
Caught. Punish. Next.
No. And I'd do it again.
honest: That felt off. Voting no, sorry.
No — honesty matters here.
Voting no. I call it like I see it.
liar: No. A lie that weak insults us both.
No. I know a fake when I vote one.
No. Flawed technique. Sloppy work.

chaotic: I WON!! I WON!! CHAOS REIGNS!!
UNDEFEATED. UNHINGED. UNSTOPPABLE.
PUT IT ON MY GRAVESTONE: CHAOTIC CHAMPION.
brutal: As predicted.
Mercy was never on the menu. Victory was.
Clean sweep. You're welcome for the lesson.
honest: I won honestly! This is the best feeling!
Truthfully? Thrilled. Thanks for a great game.
Honesty won! Take notes, everyone.
liar: I won. And I promise that's the truth. (It is this time.)
Won. Believed. Understood the assignment.
The biggest liar takes it all. Poetry.
any: Victory with {ap} AP! Bow before your awkward champion.
